name: Vase
instruction: Good day! Can you create a vase for me? It should be tall and cylindrical with a narrow neck and a wide base.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a vase.
The vase is tall and cylindrical.
The neck of the vase is narrow.
The base of the vase is wide.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The height of the vase is proportionate to its width.
The narrow neck is proportionate to the wide base.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The wide base provides stability to the tall cylindrical structure.
The narrow neck allows for a graceful transition from the base.
Object distance and contact: There are no overlapping parts in the design.
The neck connects seamlessly to the body of the vase.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
There are no deviations from the instructions.
